profile.headline: Software Engineer | Co-Founder at Riff Studios | Co-Founder Lulo Fundacion Animal
profile.summary:
Experienced software developer with full range of abilities and also Co-founder of Riff Studios.

I started my career developing with ASP 3.0 and learn even Flash for my first position. Although these are not my latest skills, I am always looking for new challenges and willing to learn and grow.

Software development ranges from a variety of soft and hard skills, and I always look for way to improve on them.

None technical skills:
     - Analyzing client requirement
     - Design sessions
     - Team work

Technical experience:
     - More than 15 years of software development.
     - REST and Web Services: My most current skill and work is related to high availability services.
     - C#: Mainly my programming language of choice but always looking for challenges. 
     - Databases: Have worked with SQL and other relational databases thought the years.
     - Azure Technologies: Use a wide range of Azure technologies
          - Cosmos DB, Table, Queue, and other types of Azure storages
          - Service Fabric
          - Life cycle management
          - AAD

positions.description: Ongoing maintenance, bug fixes, feature enhancements, and upgrades to the barrett-jackson.com website  with it’s headless CMS and its associated technologies as part of it’s company wide digital transformation.

positions.title: Founder and Game Developer at Riff Studios
positions.description:
As a Co-Founder I got the experience and pleasure to create this company and learn as we go. It is a whole new experience, and we believe we will be delivering great gaming experiences in the future.

Also, as a Game Developer I have the opportunity to work on our first game. Coffee Shop Tycoon, game me the experience to start doing game development.
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · Computer Engineering · Computer Science · C# · Unity · Coding Standards · Scalability · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Code Review

positions.title: SDE II
positions.description:
As a SDE at Microsoft I had the opportunity to work on several projects. All of these projects are high scalable services.
- Customer Master: Internal product.
- Customer Insights: As part of this team, I was involved in the provisioning and ingestion of data. We needed to build a reliable and scalable system which respond to the high demand of customers.
- Insights App Platform: Internal and in progress.
positions.insights: Skills: Representational State Transfer (REST) · Apache Spark · ASP.NET · .NET Framework · SQL · Computer Engineering · Cloud Computing · Web Services · Incident Management · Computer Science · C# · .NET Core · Coding Standards · Scalability · Hadoop · Code Review

positions.title: Allyis
positions.description:
As a SDE I worked along with Microsoft to build a high scalable service for Microsoft. 

This was an internal service which served many internal teams at Microsoft.
positions.insights: Skills: Object-Relational Mapping (ORM) · ASP.NET · .NET Framework · SQL · Computer Engineering · Cloud Computing · Web Services · Computer Science · C# · .NET Core · Coding Standards · Scalability · Code Review · Web Development

positions.title: SDE
positions.description:
•	Build, deploy and support a SQL based job engine capable of performing a daily ETL to feed partners and our data ware house.
•	Increment data quality by creating recon tool on top of our job engine. This will send reports to our Dev team in order to monitor the daily jobs.
•	Implement a Web UI (MVC with E.F) on top of the job engine to report job status, request data quality audit, job status and a self-service job setup for administrators and financial analysts. 
•	In charge of Financial Operations server. Monitor, patch and troubleshoot any server was on my daily tasks. 
•	Implement TFS in the team, this improve greatly all missing code, follow ups and so on of many task. Management was able to track activities in a more efficient way.
•	Design and build a Web based (MVC) reporting site. In this case I use Kendo UI to show the reports.
•	Build (still in progress) a new Job Engine to consume data from Cosmos.

positions.title: SDE
positions.description:
•	Review and deploy changes to the test tool. We ensure the health of all the environment’s (Dev, Test, DogFood, etc) and reduce impact to production.
•	Re write logic to support the new Intune business logic and implementations.

positions.title: Senior .NET Developer
positions.description:
•	Successfully finish the migration from the old system, from Framework 1.1 to 4; supervised 2 team members in order to achieve the teams goals. 
•	Deploy numerous new features to the marketing communication system.
•	Resolve a mayor bug in all NBC systems due a Windows patch release. This was a mayor success on the team.
•	Build and deploy SSIS packages to perform ETL.
•	Instruct in a period of 6 moths junior developers inside the team on .NET technology.

positions.title: Senior .NET Developer / White Box Tester / Project Leader
positions.description: This was and internal tool for the HR in Softtek based on Silverlight. My main activity was to develop new functionality and create a set of test for the application. Also participate in design meetings to create new modules. This system use Zentity 2.0, so this was a very unique opportunity for me to learn Zentity.

positions.title: Senior .Net Developer / White Box Tester
positions.description:
As a Senior .NET Developer / White Box tester, in this project I worked in a WCF security API based on Framework 4.0. My main task was to create test plans, implement unit test, integrations test and create a project to run this entire test’s by scenarios defined on a XML. But also I worked on development task applying design patters such as Façade, Factory and Dependency Injection (Unity 2.0).

The best part of my work here was that I started learning the meaning of “real testing”. We gave the software a higher value to our client, because we ensure that all code was cover, that if any modification is done we have a set of test to verify any problems, and best of all, that we create an automatic program to run all the scenarios defined on the XML which gave us more value.

positions.title: Application Development
positions.description:
As a Freelancer, I got involved in all the software development activities. This was one of my greatest experiences of my career because I got to do everything on my own.
We create a web application with MVP pattern. Also we used Entity Framework for data base model representation and LINQ.
positions.insights: Skills: Object-Relational Mapping (ORM) · Computer Engineering · Computer Science

positions.title: Developer
positions.description: As a .NET Developer I was in charge of creating new functionality on the new Justice System on Mexicali, B.C. For these tasks we use VS 2005, SQL Server 2005 and Oracle. Dealing with client requirements was on my activities and also use case specification and user interface specification
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · Computer Engineering · Computer Science

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
As a Developer I was able to participate on many systems. My day to day tools were ASP 3.0, SQL Server 2000, and VS 2003.
Dealing with clients and travel for software implementation were also one of my activities.
Design with Photoshop and Flash.
